items.html:
Edward Richardson is a right-arm paceman and the younger cousin of Ireland internationals John and Paul Mooney, his whole-hearted approach echoes that of his hero Brett Lee.
Cricinfo staff (February 2010)

stories.title: Sri Lanka A win despite Poynter ton
stories.subTitle: Ireland v Sri Lanka A, 1st unofficial ODI, Belfast
stories.seoTitle: Sri Lanka A win despite Poynter ton
stories.summary: Stuart Poynter scored a fighting century to rejuvenate a sinking Ireland chase but his innings couldn't quite take his team over the finish line, as Sri Lanka A wrapped up a 28-run win in the first unofficial ODI in Belfast
